entries.note: 1-1 Quiz taken; packets collected and Try Its 4 and 5 graded from them. New grading rule decided while grading: quiz counts Q3 and Q4 (10 each), Q1 is +5 bonus, and the Try Its are bonus added to the quiz (up to 5 each) rather than Assignments items; Assignments will come from Group Jams and IXL homework. 12 present: 4 perfect quizzes with empty packets (Rihanna, Idriss, Tasfia, Breilyn half of TI4), 3 lifted to full by complete packets (Amarilis, Martina, Hugo), Mariyah/Erin/Sandra mid, Dylan and Amavany 0 with a Form B retake offered after they finish the Try Its. 3 absent (Fatima, Deysi, Anderson). Tally in roster-local/quiz/2026-09-28-PeriodD-1-1-quiz.json. After lunch: IXL W42 (estimate average rate of change from a graph), BNH (find rate of change from a line graph) and PHD (average rate of change) assigned to the class, Group Jam optional; targets the Q3 misses before Form B retakes. Dylan (0 on the quiz) was the top Web Jammer on W42, as he was on Sep 21; the gap is transfer to the quiz format, not the rate skill. Rule announced to D: SmartScore 80+ on all three IXL skills (W42, BNH, PHD) replaces the 1-1 Quiz score with 20/20, so no Form B retake is needed unless a student does not do the IXL skills. Applies to Erin, Sandra, Mariyah, Dylan, Amavany (everyone under 20).
